episodes.title: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 5
episodes.short: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 5
episodes.description: In Part 5 of Mary: Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Fr. Mitch Pacwa delves into St. Luke's rich account of the Annunciation, which the Apostle likely translated from an Aramaic original.

episodes.title: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 4
episodes.short: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 4
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa continues exploring how the Ark of the Covenant and other Old Testament references illuminate and deepen our understanding of Mary as Virgin, Mother, and Queen.

episodes.title: Mail Bag Show
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa opens his mailbag and answers viewer questions on Scripture, Tradition, and a wide range of topics that matter most to the hearts of the Catholic faithful today.

episodes.title: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 3
episodes.short: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 3
episodes.description: Scripture reveals Mary in shadow long before her arrival. Fr. Mitch examines the Burning Bush and the Ark of the Covenant as Old Testament typologies of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

episodes.title: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 2
episodes.short: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 2
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa offers Old Testament background to Marian doctrine, closely examining the Temptation and Original Sin and what they reveal about Mary as Virgin, Mother, and Queen.

episodes.title: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 1
episodes.short: Mary- Virgin, Mother, and Queen, Pt. 1
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa launches a new Bible study on Marian Theology, "Mary, Virgin, Mother, and Queen," exploring what Scripture reveals about the Blessed Mother's role in our salvation.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 25
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa explores St. Paul's letter to the Ephesians, reflecting on Paul's thanks to God for Christ's blood, which bought our redemption and made us His beloved children.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 24
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa examines Colossians 3, exploring what St. Paul teaches about the fullness of life that flows from Christ's death and resurrection, and what it means for us today.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 23
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa continues "Paul on the Cross," examining St. Paul's urgent call to holiness and blamelessness within the Colossian Church as a path toward living faith and hope.

episodes.title: St. Paul on the Power of the Cross
episodes.short: St. Paul on the Power of the Cross
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa continues his study of St. Paul's letter to the Colossians, examining how Christ leads us from the dominion of darkness into His Kingdom of light, grace, and hope.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 21
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa reflects on St. Paul's exhortation to the Philippians that working out one's salvation requires sincere and active cooperation with the grace God so freely offers.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 20
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch examines St. Paul’s call to unity in the body of Christ, highlighting humility, charity, and cooperation with the Holy Spirit through the mind of Christ.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 19
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa turns to St. Paul's Letters to the Philippians and Colossians, reflecting on some of the most poignant and deeply moving passages he ever wrote to the early Church.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 18
episodes.description: While our culture flees from suffering, Fr. Mitch Pacwa examines how St. Paul's understanding of pain, prayer, and the spiritual meaning of human weakness offers a path to grace.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 17
episodes.description: As Fr. Mitch continues studying Paul on the Cross, he notes how Christians do not suffer in futility, but rather in the hope of joining Christ in a glorious resurrection like His.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 16
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa continues his series on Paul, exploring Romans 8 and how Christ's sacrifice on the cross enables the Holy Spirit as the power to conquer sin and live as Christians.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 15
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa explores St. Paul’s teaching on the Cross, revealing how Christ’s death and resurrection deepen the grace of Baptism, restoring our freedom to choose what is good.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 14
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch explores St. Paul's teaching in Romans on being justified by grace, examining how being made truly righteous by faith is the essential prerequisite for peace with God.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 13
episodes.description: Father Mitch Pacwa continues his study on Saint Paul by exploring his outreach to the Romans and how he presented the Gospel as the power of God for salvation for all who believe.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross. Pt. 12
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch explores St. Paul's bold assertion to the Galatians that neither outward appearances nor conformity to the law can compare to a faith that works itself out through love.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 11
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch reflects on Paul's call to the Galatians to turn from the law and its outward expressions, and towards the justification that comes from the death Christ bore for us.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 10
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses St. Paul’s confrontation with Judaizers seeking to impose Jewish practices on Christians, and how the Church upheld its teachings and resolved the conflict.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 9
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch explains St. Paul’s exhortations to the Corinthians and Galatians, revealing how his warnings strengthen faith, perseverance, and Christian purpose before it’s too late.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 8
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch studies St. Paul’s remarks against the false apostles, defending himself by stressing his ethnicity, weaknesses, sufferings, and the persecutions he endured for Christ.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 7
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch reflects on St. Paul’s trials in 2 Corinthians, revealing how suffering and virtue shaped him as a humble servant of Christ, faithfully proclaiming the Gospel message.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 6
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at St. Paul’s philosophy on suffering in the body, which he sees as the temple of the Holy Spirit, and the ways in which he longs for the resurrection of the body.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 5
episodes.description: While many look to St. Paul as their salvation theology source, Fr. Mitch shows how St. Paul treated his suffering and its meaning in the context of Jesus’ suffering on the cross.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 4
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch talks about St. Paul’s explanation to the Corinthians of the Eucharist which he learned from Christians who came before him based on what Christ did the eve of His death.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 3
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at how after being mocked for trying to match the lofty wisdom of the Greek philosophers, St. Paul focuses on the crucified Christ as being the foundation of faith.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 2
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch takes a look at St. Paul’s attempt to correct divisions within the Corinthian Church by emphasizing the significance of Jesus dying on the cross.

episodes.title: Paul on the Cross, Pt. 1
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch kicks off his study of St. Paul by examining his beliefs and teachings on the centrality of the Cross of Christ and its many effects on our spiritual lives.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 57
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch takes a close look at chapter 66 of the book of the Prophet Isaiah, which marks the final chapter and explains the coming of the Lord and the destruction of the wicked.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 56
episodes.description: Touching on new concepts in the Old Testament in Isaiah 65, Fr. Mitch discusses individual or group judgement by the Lord versus communal or national judgement and responsibility.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 55
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at Isaiah, chapters 63 & 64, and the evidence within that shows Lord making it clearly known that He is coming to save the city of Jerusalem.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 54
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch finishes up Isaiah 61 and begins to look at Isaiah 62 & 63 which convey God’s promise not to give up on Jerusalem but instead, to transform her into a beautiful city.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 53
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch begins looking at the core of Trito-Isaiah in chapters 60-62, specifically the Lord’s proclamation of salvation and even better things than returning to a homeland.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 52
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch addresses the final oracle in Isaiah 58 and examines Isaiah’s correction of the Israelites when they presumed the Lord was indifferent to their half-hearted fasting.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 51
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch continues in Trito-Isaiah by examining the message from the Lord for the Israelites returning from exile; a condemnation for those who strayed, and safety for the loyal.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 50
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch begins his extensive examination of “Trito-Isaiah” or “third Isaiah”, which was written sometime after the dedication of the new Temple in 516BC.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 48
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at the second part of the “Isaiah Apocalypse” in chapters 26-27, where the children of Israel returning after their exile, to a rebuilt but unfortified Jerusalem.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 47
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at Isaiah 25, the middle of what is known as the “Isaiah Apocalypse” and the song of praise to the Lord in response to Him freeing His people from exile in Babylon.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 46
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch examines the “Isaiah Apocalypse” which speaks of the destruction of the world, judgment of all nations, the redemption of Israel, and the resurrection of the dead.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 45
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at why the Lord commanded the exiled children of Israel to prepare themselves to hear God’s proclamation of salvation and institution of a new covenant with them.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 44
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at the Lord’s promises to not abandon His people, even though they were consistently unfaithful to Him as they worshipped false gods.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 43
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch explores the Fourth Song of the Servant of the Lord found in Isaiah 52-53, describing the Suffering Servant who represents God’s suffering and sacrifice for humanity.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 42
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch examines the lack of benefits the Egyptians, Assyrians and Babylonians gained from the subjugation and exile of the people of Israel, and to what this is testimony.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 41
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch dives into Isaiah 51 and 52, examining the Lord’s commands to, “Listen to me!” along with pleas from Israel to the Lord to awaken and arise to his children’s defense.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 40
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch points out the Lord’s answer to the children of Israel as they complained about exile in Babylon, while also discussing the third servant song in Isaiah 50.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 39
episodes.description: In his LIVE, interactive Bible study, Fr. Mitch begins looking at the second servant song in Isaiah 49, describing the Messiah’s mission, glory, divine origin, and purpose

episodes.title: Mail Bag Show
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses one of the most influential Old Testament books in the history of the Church, Isaiah, noting Saint Jerome’s famous line that references this important book.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 38
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses how Isaiah 47 and 48 exposes Babylon’s shame and humiliation, and what punishment follows their sinful arrogance of loving pleasure and making divine claims.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 37
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses how the Lord confronts Israel as they bristle at His decision to position a Gentile, King Cyrus, as Israel’s “Messiah”, to set them free from the Babylonians.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 36
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses a Middle Eastern King’s use of camels in battle and also looks at a shocking announcement in Isaiah 44 and 45 surrounding a Gentile, Jerusalem, and the Temple.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 35
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch studies Isaiah, chapter 44, as the Lord assures the exiled people of Israel of their future salvation and gives a strong critique of the foolish worship of pagan idols.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 34
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch studies the ways the Lord’s prophet declares the Lord is the only God who will defeat the Chaldeans of Babylon and save the spiritually blind and deaf people of Israel.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 33
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch studies the prophetic hymn of praise in Isaiah 42, while also commenting on how God deals with idolatry and how the Lord makes His truths clear for the deaf and blind.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 32
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at the first Servant of the Lord Song in Isaiah 42, making the distinction between it and the oracle of vocation which follows in Isaiah.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 31
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch takes an in depth look at Isaiah chapter 41, where God puts the nations and their Gods on trial in order to demonstrate which deity is true, the Lord or their pagan gods.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 30
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at Deutero-Isaiah, or “second Isaiah,” which takes us back to Babylon of the late 540s BC, where the Lord summons Isaiah to be a prophet to the exiles.

episodes.title: Mail Bag Show
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch breaks from his current study of Isaiah to connect with viewers by answering questions sent in via email to scriptureandtradition@ewtn.com

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 29
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch continues looking at the “Deuteronomistic History” found in Isaiah, and examines how King Hezekiah found goodness in suffering because it led him to repent of his sins.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 27
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch continues his study of the historical narratives in Isaiah 37, namely the attack on Judah by the Assyrians and the events leading up to the siege of Jerusalem.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 26
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch presents Isaiah 36-39, known as the “Deuteronomistic History,” one written at least 170 years after Isiah’s lifetime and also details his interaction with King Hezekiah.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 25
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch breaks down the oracle of salvation the Lord sent to soothe the souls of the people of Israel and explains the dire situation they were in due to their rebellious nature.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 24
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch takes a look at Isaiah 31-33 where the Lord continues to appeal to the people of Israel and instructs them to put their trust in Him instead of the Egyptian army.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 23
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses the warning prophecy for the people of Israel who rebel against God by trusting in Egypt’s Pharaoh instead of in God’s perfect timing and means of salvation.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 22
episodes.description: In his LIVE, interactive Bible Study, Fr. Mitch continues discussing the woes to the people of Israel in Isaiah 29 and 30 for their lack of trust in the Lord.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 21
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses the drunkards of Ephraim and Judah, their destruction by Assyria and the salvation of the Lord “on that day” for the remnant of survivors who fled to Jerusalem.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 20
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at the oracles from the Lord in Isaiah, and how Judah’s trust in the Egyptian Pharaoh, led to the mentality of “eat, drink and be merry, for tomorrow we die.”

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 19
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch examines (Proto) Isaiah, chapters 21 and 22, the visions of catastrophe they describe, and the meanings behind these visions.

episodes.title: Council of Nicea Special
episodes.description: In his LIVE, interactive Bible Study, as we approach the seventeen hundredth anniversary of the First Ecumenical Council of Nicea, he discusses some of the issues and problems in the Church, which led the Council to affirm the divinity of Christ and give us what we know and still recite each Sunday, the Nicene Creed.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 18
episodes.description: In his LIVE, interactive Bible study, Fr. Mitch explores the ways in which God used the Assyrian army as an effective instrument to pass His judgment on Egypt.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 17
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa continues his examination of the various oracles from the Lord against the nations in his LIVE, interactive Bible Study.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 16
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at the Lord’s complex oracle against the prideful and insolent region of Moab, which was destroyed, plundered, and its survivors scattered like helpless birds.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 15
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch examines the Lord’s comforting promises to Israel after His threat of “the Day of the Lord” in Isaiah’s prophecy stressing the terror and upheaval accompanying this day.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 14
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at Isaiah’s prophecies to the nations who were enemies of Israel, noting how God frequently acted on others based on Israel’s faithfulness to the covenant.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 13
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa takes a deeper look at some images of the time of salvation, and the prophecy of the coming Messiah within scripture in his Live, interactive Bible Study.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 12
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses how, after the chastisement from the Lord, God reassures Israel of His great love by giving them explicit hope for the reestablishment of the Davidic kingship.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 11
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses the Lord’s use of other nation’s military power to punish Israel when they rebelled against God and also how God holds those aggressor nations in check as well.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 10
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses the ninth chapter of the book of the prophet Isaiah, and how God communicates a prophetic hymn of messianic hope within times of suffering for Israel.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 9
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at chapter 8 of Isaiah and the military history of some the nations surrounding Israel which King Ahaz directly affected by ignoring the prophecies of Isaiah.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 8
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch explores Isaiah chapters 7 and 8, the prediction of the Messiah’s virgin birth and the prophecies Isaiah gave to King Ahaz warning of the peril of the kingdom of Israel.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 7
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses a description of the Lord’s final judgement within chapters five and six of Isaiah and also takes a look at Isaiah’s vision of the Lord and His Seraphim.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 6
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at chapters four and five of the book of Isaiah, calling attention to what justice, punishment, restoration and renewal of hope happens after God’s judgment.

episodes.title: Mail Bag Show
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa answers viewer questions in this comprehensive Scripture and Tradition “Mail Bag” Show! Questions can be sent to ScriptureAndTradition@ewtn.com

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 5
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at the Lord’s impending judgment on Jerusalem and Judah due to their wickedness and grave sins which were described in detail in preceding oracles.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 4
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses Isaiah, chapter 2, and the prophecy that is being fulfilled before our very eyes: that the nations will come to Zion so that the Lord may teach them His ways.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 3
episodes.description: Join Fr. Mitch as he continues his study of the Book of Isaiah. Experience the Prophet’s summons to listen to God’s instruction and his admonishment of the people’s moral character.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 2
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa begins an earnest look into the first chapter of the book of Isaiah in his LIVE and interactive Bible Study.

episodes.title: Commentary on Isaiah, Pt. 1
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch begins a new in-depth study of the book of the Prophet Isaiah, known as the Gospel of the Old Testament, and one which heavily points forward to Christ.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 79
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch takes an in depth look at how the Blessed Mother works in the lives of priests and how her help can lead them to become resilient towers of strength for the world.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 78
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch looks at Christ’s decision to hand His Blessed Mother over to the Beloved Disciple. Hear how this extended her spiritual motherhood to priests and all who call on Jesus.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 77
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch examines the Blessed Mother’s influence on the Apostles, and how we must return to Mary’s words at the wedding at Cana to grasp her faith in Jesus serving those in need.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 76
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch talks about the Blessed Virgin Mary’s impact on the Apostles and the lives of priests today, devotion to the Blessed Mother, and her importance in Christian Revelation.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 75
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch takes a deeper look at the various lists in Scripture of the Holy Spirit’s external gifts, their purpose, and how they build up the Church for the greater glory of God.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 74
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch discusses the gifts of the Holy Spirit that build up the Church and provide an antidote to cynical individualism, self-indulgence and isolation rampant in modern society.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 73
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch begins a multi-faceted look into the Gifts of the Holy Spirit and how they transform believers, through external acts, and also interiorly, with an increase in virtues.

episodes.title: Mail Bag Show
episodes.description: Accompany Fr. Mitch as he answers more in-depth email questions about the Catholic Faith, the Church, Sacred Scripture and other important topics.

episodes.title: Wheat and Tares Pt. 72
episodes.description: Fr. Mitch compares and contrasts the coming of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost with the Mount Sinai manifestation of the Lord when He gave Israel the Ten Commandments.
